items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Jacksonville: QUESTIONABLE (from Week 10) - C Robert Hainsey (knee), DE Danny Striggow (concussion). IR - OT Anton Harrison, DE B.J. Green II, S Eric Murray, DT DaVon Hamilton. RBs Bhayshul Tuten and Chris Rodriguez off the report. Trevor Lawrence starts.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. NY Giants: Jaxson Dart out for the regular season; J.J. McCarthy starts (matches schedule). QUESTIONABLE - S Jason Pinnock (back). IR - LB Brian Burns, LB Tremaine Edmunds, RB Tyrone Tracy Jr.
